9.text: on each end a drawn bow. In the middle, three large shoals of fish, flocks

10.text: of various sea-fowl, seal, and walrus are arranged somewhat symmetrically.

11.text: A plank of the same provenience (Fig. 274, b) has a large seal-net spread

12.text: on one end. A big shoal of fish and all kinds of game are represented

13.text: moving towards the net. Killer-whales are charging a group of walruses.
